trigger: P722 formal experiment revealed ceiling effect — 84% of cases are trivially separable

current_state.pipeline: 4 PDFs → P1-P6 → 9397 same-Y pairs → geometric filter (h_gap 8-50pt) → 545 candidates → stratified random → 45 cases → Human GT
current_state.selection_objective: geometry-only stratification (h_gap bin, w_b bin, line_obs bin, doc_id)
current_state.selection_note: ALL stratification dimensions are geometric. NO text content or human intuition used.

failure_diagnosis.root_cause: Geometric ambiguity filter selects geometrically close pairs, not semantically ambiguous pairs. Tables have many closely-spaced cells, so 84% of candidates are table-adjacent (trivially separable).
failure_diagnosis.mismatch_explanation: System difficulty (geometric proximity) ≠ Human difficulty (semantic ambiguity). Table cells are geometrically close but semantically trivial.

p722_experiment_evidence.ceiling_effect_evidence: B1: 100% accuracy, 100% under 3s → cases too easy, Cue cannot reduce effort
p722_experiment_evidence.interpretation: Ceiling effect makes B1-vs-B2 comparison largely uninterpretable. B2 slower may indicate Cue added processing load without benefit on easy cases.

evaluation_case_definition.candidate_vs_evaluation_case: Candidate = system-flagged pair worth considering. Evaluation Case = research-question-aligned experimental unit.
requirements: Decision boundary proximity (not obvious to all participants)

difficulty_discovery.structural_vs_human: Structural Difficulty = observable from evidence. Human Difficulty = observable through behavior only.
difficulty_discovery.circular_reasoning_prohibited: Cannot pre-label difficulty then use it to prove Cue is needed.
difficulty_discovery.discovery_loop: Candidate Pool → Structural Coverage Selection → Pilot → Human Behavior → Observed Difficulty → Future Set Refinement

steps: 2. Structural Family Classification (system groups by family)
3. Research-Question Filter (exclude trivial table cells, keep ambiguous)
5. Evidence Sufficiency Check (record availability per case)
6. Diversity/Independence Check (no page concentration, near-duplicate detection)
8. Human Difficulty Observation (time, expansion, disagreement, UNKNOWN)
9. Final Evaluation Set (frozen, pre-registered, separate from development)
principles: Structural coverage is controllable; Human difficulty is discovered
GT assigned AFTER selection, not used FOR selection
No case fabrication — only filtering of real candidates
Pilot before formal — discover difficulty behaviorally

anti_overdesign.case_builder_module: NOT NEEDED — existing scripts + better filter criteria sufficient
anti_overdesign.difficulty_engine: NOT NEEDED — Human difficulty is behavioral, discovered through pilot
anti_overdesign.semantic_difficulty_classifier: NOT NEEDED — structural family + plausible-alternative check sufficient
anti_overdesign.pattern_engine: NOT NEEDED — not relevant to case construction
anti_overdesign.learning_engine: NOT NEEDED — case construction is evaluation methodology, not system learning

human_role.principle: Human validates Cases, does not reconstruct entire set from raw candidates. System proposes, Human validates.

open_questions: What structural features distinguish trivially separable from genuinely ambiguous table cases?
How many genuinely ambiguous cases exist in the 545-candidate pool? (estimated ~77)
Should corpus be expanded for more MERGE-relevant structures?
Is 4-PDF corpus sufficient for generalization? (NO — exploratory only)
Can Human feedback inform future case selection without becoming Learning Engine? (YES — as Evaluation Design Feedback)
Should UNKNOWN cases come from evidence-poor or genuinely ambiguous cases? (Prefer genuinely ambiguous)
What minimum n for meaningful B1-vs-B2 given case difficulty? (Very large with current 84% trivial)

final_gate.CANDIDATE_CASE_SEPARATION: PASS (conceptually defined; existing pipeline conflates them)
final_gate.CASE_INDEPENDENCE: PARTIAL (page concentration in cs_001 p3: 8 cases)
final_gate.DOCUMENT_DIVERSITY: PARTIAL (4 docs, but efficientnet over-represented at 40%)
final_gate.CASE_LEAKAGE: PASS (GT not used for selection; selection was geometric only)
final_gate.HUMAN_ROLE_BOUNDARY: PASS (Human validates, system proposes — design defined)
final_gate.SYSTEM_ROLE_BOUNDARY: PASS (no runtime authority, no new modules needed)

status_rationale: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because: (1) current case set has severe ceiling effect (84% trivial, P722 B1=100% accuracy); (2) selection objective mismatch confirmed (geometric ≠ semantic); (3) future pipeline is designed but not implemented; (4) no new case set has been constructed; (5) open questions remain about genuinely ambiguous case availability in existing corpus. The design principles and pipeline are defined, but the evaluation case construction has not been demonstrated to produce a valid set.
